title: MIRRORSTORIES: Reflecting Diversity through Personalized Narrative Generation with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM (GPT-4) evaluation metrics (satisfaction, quality, engagement, personalness) of generated stories featuring male, female, and non-binary characters to identify preferential rating behaviors.

Comparing LLM (GPT-4) evaluation metrics of generated stories featuring characters from various ethnic backgrounds (e.g., Norwegian, Japanese, Russian, Pakistani, British, French) to identify rating preferences based on ethnicity.
